# thunder_ddos_dst_zone_port_zone_service_virtualhosts_virtualhost (Resource)

`thunder_ddos_dst_zone_port_zone_service_virtualhosts_virtualhost`: Configure mitigation for virtualhost

__PLACEHOLDER__



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `port_num` (String) PortNum
- `protocol` (String) Protocol
- `vhost` (String) name for virtualhost
- `zone_name` (String) ZoneName

### Optional

- `deny` (Number) Blacklist and Drop all incoming packets for protocol
- `glid_cfg` (Block List, Max: 1) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--glid_cfg))
- `level_list` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--level_list))
- `servername` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--servername))
- `servername_list` (String) Class List to match servername (AC type Class List Name)
- `servername_match_any` (Number) Match any SNI extension
- `servername_no_sni` (Number) Match when there is no SNI extension found
- `source_tracking` (String) 'follow': enable creation of source entries when source-tracking-all is enabled (default); 'enable': enable creation of source entries on this virtualhost; 'disable': disable creation of source entries on this virtualhost;
- `user_tag` (String) Customized tag
- `uuid` (String) uuid of the object

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--glid_cfg"></a>
### Nested Schema for `glid_cfg`

Optional:

- `glid` (String) Global limit ID
- `glid_action` (String) 'drop': Drop packets for glid exceed; 'ignore': Do nothing for glid exceed;


<a id="nestedblock--level_list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `level_list`

Required:

- `level_num` (String) '0': Default policy level;

Optional:

- `glid_action` (String) 'drop': Drop packets for glid exceed (Default); 'blacklist-src': Blacklist-src for glid exceed; 'ignore': Do nothing for glid exceed;
- `src_default_glid` (String) Global limit ID
- `user_tag` (String) Customized tag
- `uuid` (String) uuid of the object
- `zone_template` (Block List, Max: 1) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--level_list--zone_template))

<a id="nestedblock--level_list--zone_template"></a>
### Nested Schema for `level_list.zone_template`

Optional:

- `ssl_l4` (String) DDOS ssl-l4 template
- `tcp` (String) DDOS tcp template



<a id="nestedblock--servername"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servername`

Optional:

- `host_match_string` (String) SNI String
- `match_type` (String) 'contains': match servername extension when contains this string; 'ends-with': match servername extension when ends with this string; 'equals': match servername extension when equals this string; 'starts-with': match servername extension when starts with this string;
